chapters.title: Chapter 1 — The Invitation
intro: The seal on the temple door broke at dawn. Something inside answered your blood, Kairo.
Then I'll find out what it wants.
It wants to test you. The Ascendant Order sends its Sentinels before its letters.
outro: It fought like me. Every guard, every step.
Sentinels copy the strongest fighter they have seen. Today, that was you.
An invitation lies in its core. The Ascendant Championship has called your name.

chapters.title: Chapter 2 — Proving Ground
intro: Ladies and gentlemen — an unseeded entrant. From the Forgotten Temple… Kairo!
No crowd at the temple. I could get used to this.
Do not. The lights are there to make you careless.
outro: An upset in the qualifiers! The Sentinel is down!
The Order is watching from the top box. They didn't clap.

chapters.title: Chapter 3 — Rain Over Neon
intro: A Sentinel loose in the district, no tournament, no referee.
Someone pulled it out of the trials. Stop it before it learns the streets.
outro: Its core was rewritten. Someone wants the trials to draw blood.
Then the Order has a traitor. Or the Order is the traitor.

chapters.title: Chapter 4 — Echoes in Stone
intro: The inscription above the door: 'The first blood remembers.' It is about you.
Learned from the last heir. Your mother. Fight it like she taught you — patiently.
outro: She was faster than I thought.
She was faster than anyone thought. That is why the Order feared her.

chapters.title: Chapter 5 — The Rift Opens
intro: The semi-final! The Order has sent its Executor to face the challenger!
No more trials. They want me to lose in front of everyone.
Then win in front of everyone.
outro: Kairo advances to the final! And — the Warden himself is stepping into the ring!
Finally. The one who sends the machines.

chapters.title: Chapter 6 — Bloodline
intro: Every Sentinel was built from a fighter worth copying. I was built from the first heir.
Then you know how this ends.
I know how it began. Show me if the bloodline still remembers.
outro: The Order's machines are silent. The championship is yours, Kairo.
Not yours, not the Order's. The trials are open to everyone now.
